checks.evidence: Projection success is Phi^2. On the actual promise its means are <=delta^2/4 and >=delta^2; multiplicative concentration yields O(delta^-2 log(1/eta)) trials. Large negative Phi is outside the promise, so using a squared statistic is consistent with decoding and insufficient for domain testing. Exact domain membership is supplied by the separate circuit. Figure1 itself is the k-query projection circuit: its final Hadamards followed by the zero outcome are equivalent to projection onto the uniform state used in the lead. Proposition6 explicitly modifies that circuit with a control qubit to obtain the interference statistic. Original source images were reopened to confirm this exact attribution.
